about_the_game:
Descend into a living labyrinth in Stoneseeker, a first-person dungeon crawler that merges immersive sim gameplay with procedural design. Every floor is a test of creativity, where combat, stealth, or cleverness can prevail. There are no quest markers or scripted events, every encounter is a question, and the answer is yours.

Choose from a variety of different weapons, with unique combat and utility skills. Sneak through vents, or kick your way through the door. An ancient puzzle door might be an opportunity to flex your puzzle solving skills, or that stick of dynamite you've been saving for a special occasion. Every successful run introduces new mechanics, evolving the challenge and expanding your toolbox. And you don't have to do it alone- a mysterious floating prism called The Guide has decided to impart its strength and wisdom to you, and help you make sense of the dungeon's secrets.

Key Features

🧠 Player-Driven Problem Solving
Climb, break, sneak, or think your way through challenges. No two players will solve a room the same way.

🔁 Procedural Dungeon Generation
Each playthrough is a unique mix of handcrafted logic and algorithmic layout-biomes, puzzles, and routes shift every run.

⚔️ Tactical Gear
Choose from a growing arsenal of weapons, each with unique strengths and weaknesses. Weapons aren't just for killing anymore, each one has unique properties that you can harness in creative ways. Shoot an arrow at a lever to drop a drawbridge, or use your the knockback from your sword swing to reach a higher ledge.

🧩 Evolving Mechanics
New tools and ideas are introduced as you play the game, transforming how you engage with future puzzles and encounters.

💎 The Guide
Your sentient companion offers tutorial insight, narrative commentary, and the occasional cryptic warning. Oh? Okay... yes, you can kill it, you f***ing monster.

🎨 Striking Voxel/Low-Poly Art Style
A visually distinct blend of clean geometry and ambient atmosphere. Each biome-from ancient catacombs to collapsed mines-has a tone and visual identity of its own.

📈 Skill-Based Progression
The true meta-progression comes from learning and creative problem solving. Something that that end your first run might turn out to be barely an inconvenience during your twentieth. But there are always new challenges and lessons to be learned lurking just around the corner.

Stoneseeker is for players who crave creative freedom, creative, systemic, and emergent gameplay. Whether you’re smashing through doors or slipping through shadows, the path is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times. Game is designed to run on modest hardware.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
